title: tell or ask? to or not to?
hint: Command → **tell** sb **to** … · Request (please) → **ask** sb **to** … · negative → **not to**

items.direct: Mrs Moreno: "Mila, please help me with the dishes."
items.question: Mrs Moreno ___ Mila to help her with the dishes.
Coach Brooks ___ the team to run three more laps.

items.direct: Mr Okafor to Mila: "Don't be late."
items.question: Mr Okafor told Mila ___ late.

items.direct: Sofia to Diego: "Please lend me your charger."
items.question: Sofia asked Diego ___ her his charger.
Ms Kim told the students ___ their phones away.

items.direct: Diego to Sofia: "Don't touch my guitar!"
items.question: Diego told Sofia ___ his guitar.

items.direct: Mila to Tyler: "Please call me later."
items.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: Mila asked Tyler to call her later.
Mila asked Tyler call her later.
Mila said Tyler to call her later.
items.answer: Mila asked Tyler to call her later.

items.direct: Mrs Moreno to Diego: "Be home by ten o'clock!"
items.question: Mrs Moreno told Diego ___ by ten o'clock.
